scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm start --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server & npm test --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.deploy: npm install --production --prefix server && npm run start:prod
